correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the norming functional J_p(x), exact nonnegative scalar variational maximum, and finite energy identity with first penalty x_1^p/p and final penalty (p-1)x_n^p/p. After u=x^(p/2), homogeneous Young deficit ratio is globally bounded by positive constants, including 0 and infinity; second-order limit at equal adjacent positive entries is c_p=2(p-1)/p^2. The normalized Dirichlet sine sequence gives the limsup. The minimizing sequence has discrete Dirichlet energy O((n+1)^-2), yielding H_0^1 weak compactness and L2/uniform convergence; the exact mass quadrature tends to one. Localized weak lower semicontinuity on the positive limit set and vanishing Sobolev gradient on its zero set supply liminf c_p int|w'|², at least c_p pi² by Poincare. Independent sine recovery evaluations at n=100,500,2000 for p=1.5,2,3,4 approached the asserted coefficient, with no inference from finite tests to the limit. Real/complex, zeros, both endpoints and fixed-p quantifier checked.
